walkthroughs.body_html:
High mp/bp due to strong electrostatic forces. Brittle: like charges align under stress and repel. Conduct only when molten or dissolved.

Lattice strength rises with higher ionic charge and smaller radius: MgO mp 2852 deg C, NaCl mp 801 deg C.

Diamond: each C bonded to 4 others tetrahedrally; extremely hard, electrical insulator.

Graphite: layers of hexagons with delocalised e- between layers; conducts along layers, slippery (weak London forces between layers). Graphene is a single such layer.

Cations in a sea of delocalised valence e-. Conduct heat and electricity (mobile e-), malleable (layers slide), high mp (strong attraction).

Strength increases with charge density: Mg2+ has higher mp than Na+ because more e- contributed and smaller cation.

mcqs.q: Why does graphite conduct electricity but diamond does not?
options: Isotopes are atoms of different elements with the same mass.
Graphite conducts because it is a metal, while diamond is a non-metal.
Graphite has delocalised electrons between layers; diamond has all four outer electrons in localised covalent bonds.
Graphite conducts because it can melt easily at room temperature.

mcqs.q: Where is almost all the mass of an atom located?
options: Electrons contribute significantly to the mass of an atom.
In the nucleus, made up of protons and neutrons.
Isotopes are atoms of different elements with the same mass.
Mass is spread evenly throughout the entire atom including the electron shells.

mcqs.q: What is different between two isotopes of the same element?
options: Mass is spread evenly throughout the entire atom including the electron shells.
Isotopes have different numbers of electrons, which is why their mass differs.
They have the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons.
Isotopes are atoms of different elements with the same mass.
